NDC-2813 · New Ticket form shows the current agent as owner but saves the ticket unassigned PASS

staging-desk.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) + API · admin · QA AS6 Dept A, round robin "QA AS6 RR seq" on create (temporary), direct rule QA RT14 2813 (temporary) · 8 Nov 2026

Developer's note (2026-11-08 13:06): Fixed, live on tavi 8 Nov. Moving to Ready For Test. Cause: the New Ticket form leaves out its untouched Ticket Owner on purpose, so direct assignment rules can still decide, and the server then gave the ticket to its creator. The NDC-2275 fix of 6 Nov removed that fallback, so the ticket was saved Unassigned. This was a regression from that fix. Now (metadata-engine #213): Ticket Owner left as the signed-in agent: the ticket is theirs. A matching direct rule can still assign it to someone else. Ticket Owner cleared: the ticket stays unassigned, so round robin assigns it (the NDC-2275 retest case). An API create that declares itself (source "api" or "web_form") and names no owner: unassigned, so the rules route it. Checked live on NDC Staging in QA AS6 Dept B: an untouched owner went to the creator, a cleared owner stayed unassigned, and an API create with no owner stayed unassigned. The probe tickets were deleted.

3Owner cleared, no rule matchesUnassigned#1359 UnassignedPASS
4Owner untouched, a direct rule matchesThe rule can still assign someone else#1351 to A3 by QA RT14 2813 directPASS
